name: If Workgroup Collaboration is a Problem, How Are We Going to Collaborate With the World?
description: This Aberdeen Group presentation frames mid-1990s groupware as a rapidly growing market that is about to expand beyond departmental messaging into enterprise, intranet, and internet-enabled collaboration. It mixes market sizing and adoption data with Peter Kastner's guidance on strategy, requirements, best practices, and ROI. The deck also serves as a vendor-facing assessment of Oracle InterOffice as an extensible, server-centric collaboration platform positioned for that transition.
